name: apple-contacts
description: Find and safely manage people and groups in Apple Contacts on macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Find and safely manage contacts and groups.
interface.longDescription: Find and disambiguate contacts, inspect requested fields, create or update records, and manage groups through macOS AppleScript with privacy limits, confirmation gates, and read-back verification.
defaultPrompt: Use $apple-contacts to find a contact without exposing unrelated details.
